framework.name: 45 CFR 155.260
framework.description: Privacy and security standards for Health Insurance Exchanges under 45 CFR 155.260, governing the creation, collection, use, and disclosure of personally identifiable information (PII) for eligibility determinations under the Affordable Care Act.

controls.title: Privacy and Security of Personally Identifiable Information
controls.description: Standards for the privacy and security of personally identifiable information created, collected, used, or disclosed by Health Insurance Exchanges for eligibility and enrollment purposes.

controls.title: Exchange Privacy and Security Requirements
controls.description: Requirements governing how the Exchange must handle personally identifiable information, including creation, collection, use, disclosure, and safeguarding of such information.

controls.title: Permitted Use and Disclosure of PII
controls.description: Where the Exchange creates or collects personally identifiable information for the purposes of determining eligibility for enrollment in a qualified health plan; determining eligibility for other insurance affordability programs, as defined in §155.300; or determining eligibility for exemptions from the individual shared responsibility provisions in section 5000A of the Code, the Exchange may only use or disclose such personally identifiable information to the extent such information is necessary:

controls.title: Disclosure for Exchange Functions
controls.description: For the Exchange to carry out the functions described in §155.200;

controls.title: Secretary-Approved Disclosure with Consent
controls.description: For the Exchange to carry out other functions not described in paragraph (a)(1)(i) of this section, which the Secretary determines to be in compliance with section 1411(g)(2)(A) of the Affordable Care Act and for which an individual provides consent for his or her information to be used or disclosed; or

controls.title: Additional Secretary-Approved Uses with Consent
controls.description: For the Exchange to carry out other functions not described in paragraphs (a)(1)(i) and (ii) of this section, for which an individual provides consent for his or her information to be used or disclosed, and which the Secretary determines are in compliance with section 1411(g)(2)(A) of the Affordable Care Act under the following substantive and procedural requirements:

controls.title: HHS Approval Criteria for Additional Uses
controls.description: The Secretary may approve other uses and disclosures of personally identifiable information created or collected as described in paragraph (a)(1) of this section that are not described in paragraphs (a)(1)(i) or (ii) of this section, provided that HHS determines that the information will be used only for the purposes of and to the extent necessary in ensuring the efficient operation of the Exchange consistent with section 1411(g)(2)(A) of the Affordable Care Act, and that the uses and disclosures are also permissible under relevant law and policy.

controls.title: Submission Requirements for Additional Use Approval
controls.description: To seek approval for a use or disclosure of personally identifiable information created or collected as described in paragraph (a)(1) of this section that is not described in paragraphs (a)(1)(i) or (ii) of this section, the Exchange must submit the following information to HHS:

controls.title: Exchange Identity and Contact Information
controls.description: Identity of the Exchange and appropriate contact persons;

controls.title: Description of Proposed Use or Disclosure
controls.description: Detailed description of the proposed use or disclosure, which must include, but not necessarily be limited to, a listing or description of the specific information to be used or disclosed and an identification of the persons or entities that may access or receive the information;

controls.title: Justification for Efficient Exchange Operation
controls.description: Description of how the use or disclosure will ensure the efficient operation of the Exchange consistent with section 1411(g)(2)(A) of the Affordable Care Act; and

controls.title: Privacy and Security Protection Description
controls.description: Description of how the information to be used or disclosed will be protected in compliance with privacy and security standards that meet the requirements of this section or other relevant law, as applicable.

controls.title: Limitation on PII Creation, Collection, Use, and Disclosure
controls.description: The Exchange may not create, collect, use, or disclose personally identifiable information unless the creation, collection, use, or disclosure is consistent with this section.

controls.title: Privacy and Security Principles
controls.description: The Exchange must establish and implement privacy and security standards that are consistent with the following principles:

controls.title: Individual Access to PII
controls.description: Individuals should be provided with a simple and timely means to access and obtain their personally identifiable information in a readable form and format;

controls.title: Dispute and Correction of PII
controls.description: Individuals should be provided with a timely means to dispute the accuracy or integrity of their personally identifiable information and to have erroneous information corrected or to have a dispute documented if their requests are denied;

controls.title: Openness and Transparency
controls.description: There should be openness and transparency about policies, procedures, and technologies that directly affect individuals and/or their personally identifiable information;

controls.title: Informed Decision-Making
controls.description: Individuals should be provided a reasonable opportunity and capability to make informed decisions about the collection, use, and disclosure of their personally identifiable information;

controls.title: Purpose Limitation and Non-Discrimination
controls.description: Personally identifiable information should be created, collected, used, and/or disclosed only to the extent necessary to accomplish a specified purpose(s) and never to discriminate inappropriately;

controls.title: Data Quality and Integrity
controls.description: Persons and entities should take reasonable steps to ensure that personally identifiable information is complete, accurate, and up-to-date to the extent necessary for the person's or entity's intended purposes and has not been altered or destroyed in an unauthorized manner;

controls.title: PII Safeguards
controls.description: Personally identifiable information should be protected with reasonable operational, administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to ensure its confidentiality, integrity, and availability and to prevent unauthorized or inappropriate access, use, or disclosure; and,

controls.title: Monitoring and Breach Mitigation
controls.description: These principles should be implemented, and adherence assured, through appropriate monitoring and other means and methods should be in place to report and mitigate non-adherence and breaches.

controls.title: Operational, Technical, Administrative, and Physical Safeguards
controls.description: For the purposes of implementing the principle described in paragraph (a)(3)(vii) of this section, the Exchange must establish and implement operational, technical, administrative and physical safeguards that are consistent with any applicable laws (including this section) to ensure-

controls.title: Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability of PII
controls.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of personally identifiable information created, collected, used, and/or disclosed by the Exchange;

controls.title: Authorized Access Only
controls.description: Personally identifiable information is only used by or disclosed to those authorized to receive or view it;

controls.title: Confidentiality of Return Information
controls.description: Return information, as such term is defined by section 6103(b)(2) of the Code, is kept confidential under section 6103 of the Code;

controls.title: Protection Against Threats and Hazards
controls.description: Personally identifiable information is protected against any reasonably anticipated threats or hazards to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of such information;

controls.title: Protection Against Unauthorized Use or Disclosure
controls.description: Personally identifiable information is protected against any reasonably anticipated uses or disclosures of such information that are not permitted or required by law; and

controls.title: Secure Destruction and Disposal
controls.description: Personally identifiable information is securely destroyed or disposed of in an appropriate and reasonable manner and in accordance with retention schedules;

controls.title: Continuous Security Monitoring and Assessment
controls.description: The Exchange must monitor, periodically assess, and update the security controls and related system risks to ensure the continued effectiveness of those controls.

controls.title: Secure Electronic Interfaces
controls.description: The Exchange must develop and utilize secure electronic interfaces when sharing personally identifiable information electronically.

controls.title: Non-Exchange Entity Requirements
controls.description: Requirements governing non-Exchange entities that gain access to, collect, use, or disclose personally identifiable information in connection with Exchange functions, including contractual obligations and privacy and security standards.

controls.title: Definition of Non-Exchange Entity
controls.description: A nonExchange entity is any individual or entity that:

controls.title: Access to Exchange PII
controls.description: Gains access to personally identifiable information submitted to an Exchange; or

controls.title: Direct Collection from Applicants
controls.description: Collects, uses, or discloses personally identifiable information gathered directly from applicants, qualified individuals, or enrollees while that individual or entity is performing functions agreed to with the Exchange.

controls.title: Contract Requirements for Non-Exchange Entities
controls.description: Prior to any person or entity becoming a non-Exchange entity, Exchanges must execute with the person or entity a contract or agreement that includes:

controls.title: Function Description
controls.description: A description of the functions to be performed by the non-Exchange entity;

controls.title: Privacy and Security Compliance Binding
controls.description: A provision(s) binding the nonExchange entity to comply with the privacy and security standards and obligations adopted in accordance with paragraph (b)(3) of this section, and specifically listing or incorporating those privacy and security standards and obligations;

controls.title: Security Monitoring Requirement
controls.description: A provision requiring the nonExchange entity to monitor, periodically assess, and update its security controls and related system risks to ensure the continued effectiveness of those controls in accordance with paragraph (a)(5) of this section;

controls.title: Material Change Notification
controls.description: A provision requiring the non-Exchange entity to inform the Exchange of any change in its administrative, technical, or operational environments defined as material within the contract; and

controls.title: Downstream Entity Binding
controls.description: A provision that requires the nonExchange entity to bind any downstream entities to the same privacy and security standards and obligations to which the non-Exchange entity has agreed in its contract or agreement with the Exchange.

controls.title: Privacy and Security Standards for Non-Exchange Entities
controls.description: When collection, use or disclosure is not otherwise required by law, the privacy and security standards to which an Exchange binds non-Exchange entities must:

controls.title: Consistency with Exchange Standards
controls.description: Be consistent with the principles and requirements listed in paragraphs (a)(1) through (6) of this section, including being at least as protective as the standards the Exchange has established and implemented for itself in compliance with paragraph (a)(3) of this section;

controls.title: Compliance with Additional Requirements
controls.description: Comply with the requirements of paragraphs (c), (d), (f), and (g) of this section; and

controls.title: Specific Considerations for Non-Exchange Standards
controls.description: Take into specific consideration:

controls.title: Operating Environment Consideration
controls.description: The environment in which the non-Exchange entity is operating;

controls.title: Relevance to Entity Activities
controls.description: Whether the standards are relevant and applicable to the non-Exchange entity's duties and activities in connection with the Exchange; and

controls.title: Existing Legal Requirements
controls.description: Any existing legal requirements to which the non-Exchange entity is bound in relation to its administrative, technical, and operational controls and practices, including but not limited to, its existing data handling and information technology processes and protocols.

controls.title: Workforce Compliance
controls.description: The Exchange must ensure its workforce complies with the policies and procedures developed and implemented by the Exchange to comply with this section.

controls.title: Written Policies and Procedures
controls.description: Policies and procedures regarding the creation collection, use, and disclosure of personally identifiable information must, at minimum:

controls.title: Written Documentation and Availability
controls.description: Be in writing, and available to the Secretary of HHS upon request; and

controls.title: Identification of Applicable Law
controls.description: Identify applicable law governing collection, use, and disclosure of personally identifiable information.

controls.title: Data Sharing with Medicaid, CHIP, and BHP
controls.description: Data matching and sharing arrangements that facilitate the sharing of personally identifiable information between the Exchange and agencies administering Medicaid, CHIP or the BHP for the exchange of eligibility information must:

controls.title: Compliance with Section Requirements
controls.description: Meet any applicable requirements described in this section;

controls.title: Affordable Care Act Compliance
controls.description: Meet any applicable requirements described in section 1413(c)(1) and (c)(2) of the Affordable Care Act;

controls.title: Medicaid Stringency Requirements
controls.description: Be equal to or more stringent than the requirements for Medicaid programs under section 1942 of the Act; and

controls.title: Matching Program Compliance
controls.description: For those matching agreements that meet the definition of 'matching program' under 5 U.S.C. 552a(a)(8), comply with 5 U.S.C. 552a(o).

controls.title: Confidentiality of Return Information
controls.description: Return information, as defined in section 6103(b)(2) of the Code, must be kept confidential and disclosed, used, and maintained only in accordance with section 6103 of the Code.

controls.title: Civil Monetary Penalties for Violations
controls.description: Any person who knowingly and willfully uses or discloses information in violation of section 1411(g) of the Affordable Care Act will be subject to a CMP of not more than $25,000 as adjusted annually under 45 CFR part 102 per person or entity, per use or disclosure, consistent with the bases and process for imposing civil penalties specified at §155.285, in addition to other penalties that may be prescribed by law.
